title: Calderone Farms Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Calderone Golf Club offers an experience unlike any other Mid-Michigan golf course. The layout features a mix of Scottish-Style links golf with traditional Parkland golf. When you tee off you will encounter large undulating greens, wide landing areas and long drive - totaling over 7,000 yards from the back tees. What are you waiting for?
